<details>
<summary><code>/home/harry/test/tt_pangu/.claude/worktrees/m8-loop/ui/src/pages/RunTimeline.tsx</code></summary>

```typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type AgentJob,
  type AgentJobEvent,
  type AgentTelemetrySpan,
} from "../lib/db";

const EVENT_TYPES = [
  "tool_call",
  "tool_result",
  "decision_request",
  "approval_pause",
  "reviewer_reject",
  "review_verdict",
  "budget_warning",
  "error",
];

function SpanLane({
  spans,
  jobStart,
}: {
  spans: AgentTelemetrySpan[];
  jobStart: number;
}): JSX.Element {
  if (spans.length === 0) return <Empty>No spans for this job.</Empty>;
  const ends = spans.map((s) =>
    s.ended_at ? new Date(s.ended_at).getTime() : Date.now(),
  );
  const maxEnd = Math.max(...ends);
  const dur = Math.max(1, maxEnd - jobStart);
  const groups = Array.from(new Set(spans.map((s) => s.kind || s.name)));
  const width = 800;
  const rowHeight = 22;
  const padding = 4;

  return (
    <svg
      data-testid="swim-lane"
      width={width}
      height={groups.length * rowHeight + 2 * padding}
      role="img"
      aria-label="run timeline swim-lane"
      className="rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white"
    >
      {groups.map((g, i) => (
        <g key={g} transform={`translate(0, ${padding + i * rowHeight})`}>
          <text x={2} y={14} className="fill-slate-500 text-[10px]">
            {g}
          </text>
          {spans
            .filter((s) => (s.kind || s.name) === g)
            .map((s, j) => {
              const start = new Date(s.started_at).getTime();
              const end = s.ended_at
                ? new Date(s.ended_at).getTime()
                : start + 100;
              const x = 60 + ((start - jobStart) / dur) * (width - 80);
              const w = Math.max(2, ((end - start) / dur) * (width - 80));
              const fill =
                s.status === "error"
                  ? "#fca5a5"
                  : s.ended_at
                    ? "#86efac"
                    : "#fde68a";
              return (
                <g key={j}>
                  <rect
                    x={x}
                    y={2}
                    width={w}
                    height={rowHeight - 6}
                    fill={fill}
                  >
                    <title>
                      {s.name} • {s.duration_ms ?? 0}ms •{" "}
                      {JSON.stringify(s.attributes ?? {})}
                    </title>
                  </rect>
                </g>
              );
            })}
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

function EventLog({ events }: { events: AgentJobEvent[] }): JSX.Element {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const pageSize = 25;
  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => (filter ? events.filter((e) => e.event_type === filter) : events),
    [events, filter],
  );
  const pageRows = filtered.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <label className="text-xs text-slate-500">Filter:</label>
        <select
          value={filter}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setFilter(e.target.value);
            setPage(0);
          }}
          className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-sm"
        >
          <option value="">all</option>
          {EVENT_TYPES.map((t) => (
            <option key={t} value={t}>
              {t}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          {filtered.length} events
        </span>
      </div>
      <Table
        rows={pageRows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "ts",
            header: "ts",
            render: (e) => e.created_at.slice(11, 19),
          },
          {
            key: "type",
            header: "type",
            render: (e) => <Badge>{e.event_type}</Badge>,
          },
          {
            key: "summary",
            header: "summary",
            render: (e) => {
              const ed: any = e.event_data ?? {};
              const summary = ed.tool ?? ed.operation ?? ed.verdict ?? "";
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="text-left text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [e.id]: !o[e.id] }))
                  }
                >
                  {summary || "—"}
                  {open[e.id] && (
                    <pre className="mt-1 max-w-lg overflow-x-auto rounded bg-slate-50 p-2 text-[11px]">
                      {JSON.stringify(e.event_data, null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            },
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No events.</Empty>}
      />
      {filtered.length > pageSize && (
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={page === 0}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
            className="disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            ← prev
          </button>
          <span>
            page {page + 1} / {Math.ceil(filtered.length / pageSize)}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={(page + 1) * pageSize >= filtered.length}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            className="disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            next →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function RunTimeline(): JSX.Element {
  const { jobId } = useParams<{ jobId: string }>();
  const [job, setJob] = useState<AgentJob | null>(null);
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<AgentJobEvent[]>([]);
  const [spans, setSpans] = useState<AgentTelemetrySpan[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId) return;
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [j, e, s] = await Promise.all([
          db.getJob(jobId),
          db.listJobEvents(jobId),
          db.listJobSpans(jobId),
        ]);
        if (!live) return;
        setJob(j);
        setEvents(e);
        setSpans(s);
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [jobId]);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (!job) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <Empty>
          Job not found.{" "}
          <Link to="/runs" className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline">
            ← back to runs
          </Link>
        </Empty>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const jobStart = job.started_at
    ? new Date(job.started_at).getTime()
    : new Date(job.created_at).getTime();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card title="Job summary">
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm md:grid-cols-4">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">skill</dt>
            <dd>{(job.policy as any)?.skill_name ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">status</dt>
            <dd>
              <Badge>{job.status}</Badge>
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">turns</dt>
            <dd>{job.turns_used ?? 0}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">cost ($)</dt>
            <dd>{(job.cost_usd ?? 0).toFixed(4)}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">started</dt>
            <dd>{job.started_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">ended</dt>
            <dd>{job.finished_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </Card>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Card title="Spans" className="lg:col-span-2">
          <SpanLane spans={spans} jobStart={jobStart} />
        </Card>
        <Card title="Event log">
          <EventLog events={events} />
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner, Table, Badge } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type Experiment,
  type Run,
  type Submission,
} from "../lib/db";

type SortKey = "ts" | "cv" | "lb";
type SortDir = "asc" | "desc";

interface Row {
  experiment: Experiment;
  bestCv: number | null;
  lastLb: number | null;
  lastRun: Run | null;
  lastSubmission: Submission | null;
}

export function Experiments(): JSX.Element {
  const [exps, setExps] = useState<Experiment[]>([]);
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<Run[]>([]);
  const [subs, setSubs] = useState<Submission[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submittedOnly, setSubmittedOnly] = useState(false);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const pageSize = 25;
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<SortKey>("ts");
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<SortDir>("desc");

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [e, s] = await Promise.all([
          db.listExperiments(200),
          db.listSubmissions(200),
        ]);
        if (!live) return;
        setExps(e);
        setSubs(s);
        // Fetch runs for each experiment (parallel, capped).
        const allRuns: Run[] = [];
        for (const exp of e.slice(0, 200)) {
          try {
            const r = await db.listRunsForExperiment(exp.id);
            allRuns.push(...r);
          } catch {
            /* ignore */
          }
        }
        if (live) setRuns(allRuns);
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const rows = useMemo<Row[]>(() => {
    return exps.map((exp) => {
      const expRuns = runs.filter((r) => r.experiment_id === exp.id);
      const expSubs = subs.filter((s) =>
        expRuns.some((r) => r.id === s.run_id),
      );
      const cvs = expRuns
        .map((r) => (r.metrics ?? {})["cv_score"])
        .filter((v): v is number => typeof v === "number");
      const bestCv = cvs.length ? Math.max(...cvs) : null;
      const lastSub =
        expSubs.length > 0
          ? [...expSubs].sort((a, b) =>
              (b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.created_at ?? ""),
            )[0]
          : null;
      const lastLb = lastSub?.public_lb_score ?? null;
      const lastRun =
        expRuns.length > 0
          ? [...expRuns].sort((a, b) =>
              (b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.created_at ?? ""),
            )[0]
          : null;
      return {
        experiment: exp,
        bestCv,
        lastLb,
        lastRun,
        lastSubmission: lastSub,
      };
    });
  }, [exps, runs, subs]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let out = rows;
    if (submittedOnly) out = out.filter((r) => r.lastSubmission);
    if (statusFilter)
      out = out.filter((r) => (r.experiment.status ?? "") === statusFilter);
    return out;
  }, [rows, submittedOnly, statusFilter]);

  const sorted = useMemo(() => {
    const out = [...filtered];
    out.sort((a, b) => {
      let av: number | string = "";
      let bv: number | string = "";
      if (sortKey === "ts") {
        av = a.experiment.created_at;
        bv = b.experiment.created_at;
      } else if (sortKey === "cv") {
        av = a.bestCv ?? -Infinity;
        bv = b.bestCv ?? -Infinity;
      } else if (sortKey === "lb") {
        av = a.lastLb ?? -Infinity;
        bv = b.lastLb ?? -Infinity;
      }
      const cmp = av < bv ? -1 : av > bv ? 1 : 0;
      return sortDir === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
    return out;
  }, [filtered, sortKey, sortDir]);

  const pageRows = sorted.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize);

  function toggleSort(key: SortKey): void {
    if (sortKey === key) {
      setSortDir((d) => (d === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"));
    } else {
      setSortKey(key);
      setSortDir(key === "ts" ? "desc" : "desc");
    }
    setPage(0);
  }

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  const arrow = (k: SortKey): string =>
    sortKey === k ? (sortDir === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : "";

  return (
    <Card title="Experiments">
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">
        <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={submittedOnly}
            onChange={(e) => setSubmittedOnly(e.target.checked)}
          />
          submitted only
        </label>
        <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          status:
          <input
            type="text"
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="(any)"
            className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs"
          />
        </label>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-slate-500">
          {filtered.length} experiments
        </span>
      </div>
      <Table
        rows={pageRows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "id",
            header: "Experiment",
            render: (r) => (
              <Link
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                to={`/experiments/${r.experiment.id}`}
              >
                {r.experiment.id.slice(0, 8)}
              </Link>
            ),
          },
          {
            key: "hyp",
            header: "Hypothesis",
            render: (r) => r.experiment.hypothesis ?? "—",
          },
          {
            key: "ts",
            header: <>Created{arrow("ts")}</>,
            sortable: true,
            onSort: () => toggleSort("ts"),
            render: (r) => r.experiment.created_at.slice(0, 10),
          },
          {
            key: "cv",
            header: <>CV{arrow("cv")}</>,
            sortable: true,
            onSort: () => toggleSort("cv"),
            align: "right",
            render: (r) => (r.bestCv == null ? "—" : r.bestCv.toFixed(4)),
          },
          {
            key: "lb",
            header: <>LB{arrow("lb")}</>,
            sortable: true,
            onSort: () => toggleSort("lb"),
            align: "right",
            render: (r) => (r.lastLb == null ? "—" : r.lastLb.toFixed(4)),
          },
          {
            key: "status",
            header: "Status",
            render: (r) => <Badge>{r.experiment.status ?? "—"}</Badge>,
          },
          {
            key: "last",
            header: "Last run",
            render: (r) =>
              r.lastRun?.job_id ? (
                <Link
                  className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                  to={`/runs/${r.lastRun.job_id}`}
                >
                  open
                </Link>
              ) : (
                "—"
              ),
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No experiments match the filters.</Empty>}
      />
      {sorted.length > pageSize && (
        <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={page === 0}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
          >
            ← prev
          </button>
          <span>
            page {page + 1} / {Math.ceil(sorted.length / pageSize)}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={(page + 1) * pageSize >= sorted.length}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
          >
            next →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

```

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import { db, type Run } from "../lib/db";

export function RunDetail(): JSX.Element {
  const { experimentId } = useParams<{ experimentId: string }>();
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<Run[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!experimentId) return;
    db.listRunsForExperiment(experimentId)
      .then(setRuns)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [experimentId]);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  return (
    <Card title={`Experiment ${experimentId?.slice(0, 8) ?? ""}`}>
      <Table
        rows={runs.flatMap((r) =>
          Object.entries(r.metrics ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => ({
            runId: r.id,
            ts: r.created_at,
            key: k,
            value: v,
            jobId: r.job_id,
            artifactPaths: r.artifact_paths,
          })),
        )}
        columns={[
          { key: "ts", header: "ts", render: (m) => m.ts.slice(0, 19) },
          { key: "metric", header: "Metric", render: (m) => m.key },
          {
            key: "val",
            header: "Value",
            align: "right",
            render: (m) =>
              typeof m.value === "number" ? m.value.toFixed(4) : String(m.value),
          },
          {
            key: "run",
            header: "Job",
            render: (m) =>
              m.jobId ? (
                <Link
                  className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                  to={`/runs/${m.jobId}`}
                >
                  {m.jobId.slice(0, 8)}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                "—"
              ),
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No metrics recorded.</Empty>}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

    expect(rowsText[2]).toMatch(/e1/);
  });
});

````typescript
/**
 * Tiny safe Markdown renderer.
 *
 * Intentionally no remote dependency. Supports headings, paragraphs,
 * inline code, fenced code blocks, lists, and links. Everything else falls
 * through as plain text. Hostile inputs (`<script>`, `javascript:` URLs,
 * inline event handlers) are stripped — we never inject raw user HTML.
 */

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function sanitiseHref(href: string): string {
  const trimmed = href.trim();
  if (/^javascript:/i.test(trimmed)) return "#";
  if (/^data:/i.test(trimmed)) return "#";
  return trimmed;
}

export function renderMarkdown(src: string): string {
  if (!src) return "";

  const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
  let html = "";
  let inCode = false;
  let inList = false;

  for (const raw of lines) {
    if (raw.startsWith("```")) {
      if (inCode) {
        html += "</code></pre>";
        inCode = false;
      } else {
        if (inList) {
          html += "</ul>";
          inList = false;
        }
        html += "<pre><code>";
        inCode = true;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (inCode) {
      html += escapeHtml(raw) + "\n";
      continue;
    }

    if (raw.startsWith("# ")) {
      if (inList) {
        html += "</ul>";
        inList = false;
      }
      html += `<h1>${inline(escapeHtml(raw.slice(2)))}</h1>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (raw.startsWith("## ")) {
      if (inList) {
        html += "</ul>";
        inList = false;
      }
      html += `<h2>${inline(escapeHtml(raw.slice(3)))}</h2>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (raw.startsWith("- ") || raw.startsWith("* ")) {
      if (!inList) {
        html += "<ul>";
        inList = true;
      }
      html += `<li>${inline(escapeHtml(raw.slice(2)))}</li>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (raw.trim() === "") {
      if (inList) {
        html += "</ul>";
        inList = false;
      }
      continue;
    }

    html += `<p>${inline(escapeHtml(raw))}</p>`;
  }

  if (inCode) html += "</code></pre>";
  if (inList) html += "</ul>";
  return html;
}

function inline(s: string): string {
  // Strip any HTML tags that slipped through escapeHtml (defensive: should
  // be impossible since we already escaped them).
  s = s.replace(/(?:<[^>]+>)/g, "");
  // Inline code
  s = s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "<code>$1</code>");
  // Links: [text](url) — sanitise href.
  s = s.replace(
    /\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,
    (_match, text: string, url: string) => {
      const href = sanitiseHref(url);
      return `<a href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${text}</a>`;
    },
  );
  // Image: ![alt](url) → load-image placeholder, never auto-fetched.
  s = s.replace(
    /!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,
    (_match, alt: string, url: string) => {
      const safe = sanitiseHref(url);
      return `<span class="rounded bg-slate-100 px-1 text-xs text-slate-600">[image: ${alt || safe}]</span>`;
    },
  );
  return s;
}

```typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Card, Empty, Spinner } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type ResearchCitation,
  type ResearchItem,
} from "../lib/db";
import { renderMarkdown } from "../lib/markdown";

function trustColor(trust: string): "green" | "amber" | "red" {
  if (trust === "high") return "green";
  if (trust === "medium") return "amber";
  return "red";
}

export function Research(): JSX.Element {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ResearchItem[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [citations, setCitations] = useState<ResearchCitation[]>([]);
  const [showSource, setShowSource] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    db.listResearchItems(50)
      .then((r) => {
        if (!live) return;
        setItems(r);
        if (r.length > 0) setSelected(r[0].id);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selected) return;
    db.listCitationsForRun(selected).then(setCitations).catch(() => setCitations([]));
  }, [selected]);

  const active = useMemo(
    () => items.find((i) => i.id === selected) ?? null,
    [items, selected],
  );

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (items.length === 0)
    return (
      <Card title="Research">
        <Empty>No research items yet.</Empty>
      </Card>
    );

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Card title="Items" className="lg:col-span-1">
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {items.map((it) => (
            <li key={it.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelected(it.id)}
                className={`block w-full rounded p-2 text-left text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 ${
                  selected === it.id ? "bg-indigo-50" : ""
                }`}
              >
                <div className="font-medium">{it.title ?? it.url}</div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <Badge color={trustColor(it.trust)}>{it.trust}</Badge>
                  <a
                    href={it.url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="truncate hover:underline"
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  >
                    {it.url}
                  </a>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-400">
                  fetched {it.fetched_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—"}
                </div>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Card>
      <Card title={active?.title ?? "Item"} className="lg:col-span-2">
        {active ? (
          <div>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <Badge color={trustColor(active.trust)}>{active.trust}</Badge>
              <a
                href={active.url}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
              >
                source ↗
              </a>
            </div>
            <article
              className="prose prose-sm max-w-none"
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
                __html: renderMarkdown(active.summary ?? ""),
              }}
            />
            <h3 className="mt-6 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Citations
            </h3>
            {citations.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty>No citations for this run.</Empty>
            ) : (
              <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-700">
                {citations.map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.id} className="rounded border border-slate-100 p-2">
                    {c.quote && <p className="italic">"{c.quote}"</p>}
                    {c.job_id && (
                      <Link
                        to={`/runs/${c.job_id}`}
                        className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                      >
                        job {c.job_id.slice(0, 8)}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            <details
              className="mt-6"
              open={showSource}
              onToggle={(e) => setShowSource((e.target as HTMLDetailsElement).open)}
            >
              <summary className="cursor-pointer text-xs text-slate-500">
                raw source
              </summary>
              <pre className="mt-2 overflow-x-auto rounded bg-slate-50 p-2 text-[10px] text-slate-700">
                {active.url}
              </pre>
            &lt;/details>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Empty>Select an item.</Empty>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

```

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { renderMarkdown } from "./markdown";

describe("renderMarkdown sanitiser", () => {
  it("escapes <script> tags", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("# hi\n\n<script>alert(1)</script>\n");
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(out).toContain("&lt;script&gt;");
  });

  it("strips javascript: hrefs from links", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("[click](javascript:alert(1))");
    expect(out).toContain('href="#"');
    expect(out).not.toContain("javascript:");
  });

  it("adds rel=noopener noreferrer to links", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("[ok](https://example.com)");
    expect(out).toContain('rel="noopener noreferrer"');
    expect(out).toContain('target="_blank"');
  });

  it("placeholders images instead of fetching them", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("![alt](https://remote.example.com/x.png)");
    expect(out).not.toContain("<img");
    expect(out).toContain("[image:");
  });
});

"""kca decisions: list, approve, and deny human approval requests."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json

from _types import EXIT_OK, EXIT_RUNTIME, SideEffect


def _emit(ok: bool, payload: dict, exit_code: int = EXIT_OK) -> int:
    print(json.dumps({"ok": ok, **payload}, ensure_ascii=False))
    return exit_code


def _load_db():
    """Import db module; raise ImportError or DBNotConfigured if unavailable."""
    import db as _db

    return _db


def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    try:
        _db = _load_db()
        job_id = getattr(args, "job_id", None)
        rows = _db.list_pending_decisions(job_id=job_id)
        decisions = [
            {
                "id": str(r.get("id", "")),
                "decision_type": r.get("decision_type", ""),
                "status": r.get("status", ""),
                "prompt": r.get("prompt", ""),
                "created_at": str(r.get("created_at", "")),
                "job_id": str(r.get("job_id", "")) if r.get("job_id") else None,
            }
            for r in rows
        ]
        payload: dict = {
            "decisions": decisions,
            "side_effect": SideEffect.READ_ONLY.value,
        }
        if getattr(args, "include_reviews", False):
            review_rows = _db.list_reviews(job_id=job_id, limit=50)
            payload["reviews"] = [
                {
                    "id": str(r.get("id", "")),
                    "job_id": str(r.get("job_id", "")) if r.get("job_id") else None,
                    "verdict": r.get("verdict", ""),
                    "target_op": r.get("target_op", ""),
                    "reviewer_model": r.get("reviewer_model", ""),
                    "rationale": (r.get("rationale") or "")[:200],
                    "created_at": str(r.get("created_at", "")),
                }
                for r in review_rows
            ]
        return _emit(True, payload)
    except Exception as exc:
        # Exit 0 with ok=false for graceful DB-unavailable degradation.
        return _emit(False, {"error": str(exc), "decisions": []})

```python
"""FastAPI action service for the M8 Decision Gate UI.

The browser never holds a service-role Supabase key. It posts to
``/decision/<id>/approve|reject|ask-improve``; this service re-uses the
existing ``tools/kca/decisions.py`` functions and ``tools/kca/db.py`` writes
so the M7 permission policy stays authoritative.

Auth: a shared token in ``KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN``. Requests must include the
matching ``X-Decision-Api-Token`` header. Multi-user auth lands in M9+.

Testing: pass a ``decisions_module`` override (e.g. via dependency injection)
to swap in a mocked DB layer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hmac
import os
from typing import Callable, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Header, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


TOKEN_ENV = "KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN"


class ApproveBody(BaseModel):
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class RejectBody(BaseModel):
    reason: str = Field(..., min_length=8, max_length=2000)


class AskImproveBody(BaseModel):
    feedback: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4000)
    metric_target: Optional[str] = None


def _check_token(provided: Optional[str]) -> None:
    expected = os.environ.get(TOKEN_ENV, "")
    if not expected:
        # If the server has no token configured, accept any (local dev only).
        return
    if not provided or not hmac.compare_digest(provided, expected):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="invalid token")


def make_app(
    decisions_module: Optional[object] = None,
    audit_logger: Optional[Callable] = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    """Construct the FastAPI app.

    ``decisions_module`` exposes ``get_decision``, ``resolve_decision``, and
    ``append_job_event``. Tests pass a fake module to avoid touching Supabase.
    """
    app = FastAPI(title="kca decision_api", version="0.1.0")

    def _resolve_db():
        if decisions_module is not None:
            return decisions_module
        import sys
        from pathlib import Path

        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "tools" / "kca"))
        import db as _db  # type: ignore

        return _db

    def _audit(*, decision: str, decision_id: str, reason: Optional[str]) -> None:
        if audit_logger is not None:
            audit_logger(
                decision=decision, decision_id=decision_id, reason=reason or ""
            )
            return
        try:
            from tools.kca.agent.audit import log_policy_decision  # type: ignore

            log_policy_decision(
                tool="decision_api",
                operation=f"decision_{decision}",
                decision="allow",
                policy_profile="default",
                args={"decision_id": decision_id, "reason_len": len(reason or "")},
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _get_pending(decision_id: str):
        _db = _resolve_db()
        row = _db.get_decision(decision_id)
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
        if row.get("status") != "pending":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail=f"decision is {row.get('status')}, not pending",
            )
        return row

    @app.post("/decision/{decision_id}/approve")
    def approve(
        decision_id: str,
        body: ApproveBody,
        x_decision_api_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    ) -> dict:
        _check_token(x_decision_api_token)
        row = _get_pending(decision_id)
        _db = _resolve_db()
        _db.resolve_decision(decision_id, "approved", notes=body.reason)
        _audit(decision="approve", decision_id=decision_id, reason=body.reason)
        return {"ok": True, "decision_id": decision_id, "status": "approved", "job_id": row.get("job_id")}

    @app.post("/decision/{decision_id}/reject")
    def reject(
        decision_id: str,
        body: RejectBody,
        x_decision_api_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    ) -> dict:
        _check_token(x_decision_api_token)
        row = _get_pending(decision_id)
        _db = _resolve_db()
        _db.resolve_decision(decision_id, "rejected", notes=body.reason)
        _audit(decision="reject", decision_id=decision_id, reason=body.reason)
        return {"ok": True, "decision_id": decision_id, "status": "rejected", "job_id": row.get("job_id")}

    @app.post("/decision/{decision_id}/ask-improve")
    def ask_improve(
        decision_id: str,
        body: AskImproveBody,
        x_decision_api_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    ) -> dict:
        _check_token(x_decision_api_token)
        row = _get_pending(decision_id)
        _db = _resolve_db()
        # Append a feedback event so the worker can pick it up on resume.
        if row.get("job_id"):
            _db.append_job_event(
                job_id=str(row["job_id"]),
                event_type="feedback",
                event_data={
                    "feedback": body.feedback,
                    "metric_target": body.metric_target,
                    "source": "decision_api.ask_improve",
                },
            )
        _db.resolve_decision(decision_id, "needs_improvement", notes=body.feedback)
        _audit(decision="ask_improve", decision_id=decision_id, reason=body.feedback)
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "decision_id": decision_id,
            "status": "needs_improvement",
            "job_id": row.get("job_id"),
        }

    return app


app = make_app()

```

"""decision_api tests with a mocked DB layer (no real Supabase calls)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import types
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from services.decision_api.app import make_app


class FakeDB:
    """In-memory stand-in for tools/kca/db. Captures calls so tests can assert."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.decisions: dict = {
            "abc": {
                "id": "abc",
                "status": "pending",
                "job_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
                "decision_type": "kaggle_submit",
            },
            "open2": {
                "id": "open2",
                "status": "pending",
                "job_id": None,
                "decision_type": "external_fetch",
            },
        }
        self.events: list[dict] = []

    def get_decision(self, decision_id: str) -> dict | None:
        return self.decisions.get(decision_id)

    def resolve_decision(self, decision_id: str, resolution: str, notes=None) -> None:
        self.decisions[decision_id]["status"] = resolution
        self.decisions[decision_id]["notes"] = notes

    def append_job_event(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        event_data=None,
        **_kwargs,
    ) -> int:
        evt = {"job_id": job_id, "event_type": event_type, "event_data": event_data}
        self.events.append(evt)
        return len(self.events)


@pytest.fixture
def client() -> TestClient:
    fake = FakeDB()
    app = make_app(decisions_module=fake, audit_logger=lambda **_: None)
    c = TestClient(app)
    c.app = app  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    c.fake = fake  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return c


def test_decision_api_approve_idempotent(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r1 = client.post("/decision/abc/approve", json={"reason": "ok"})
    assert r1.status_code == 200, r1.text
    assert r1.json()["status"] == "approved"

    r2 = client.post("/decision/abc/approve", json={"reason": "ok"})
    assert r2.status_code == 409, r2.text


def test_decision_api_reject_minlength(client: TestClient) -> None:
    short = client.post("/decision/abc/reject", json={"reason": "short"})  # 5
    assert short.status_code == 422

    ok = client.post(
        "/decision/abc/reject", json={"reason": "explanation"}
    )
    assert ok.status_code == 200
    assert ok.json()["status"] == "rejected"


def test_decision_api_ask_improve_appends_event(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.post(
        "/decision/abc/ask-improve",
        json={"feedback": "please retry with seed=42"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    fake = client.fake  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    feedback_events = [e for e in fake.events if e["event_type"] == "feedback"]
    assert feedback_events, "expected a feedback event"
    assert feedback_events[0]["event_data"]["feedback"].startswith("please retry")


def test_decision_api_404_for_unknown(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.post("/decision/no_such/approve", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 404


def test_decision_api_token_required(monkeypatch) -> None:
    fake = FakeDB()
    monkeypatch.setenv("KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN", "secret")
    app = make_app(decisions_module=fake, audit_logger=lambda **_: None)
    c = TestClient(app)
    r = c.post("/decision/abc/approve", json={"reason": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 401
    r2 = c.post(
        "/decision/abc/approve",
        json={"reason": "x"},
        headers={"X-Decision-Api-Token": "secret"},
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 200

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import { db, type HumanDecision } from "../lib/db";

export function ApprovalInbox(): JSX.Element {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<HumanDecision[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    db.listPendingDecisions()
      .then(setRows)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  return (
    <Card title="Approval Inbox">
      <Table
        rows={rows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "operation",
            header: "Operation",
            render: (d) => (
              <Link
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                to={`/approvals/${d.id}`}
              >
                {d.decision_type}
              </Link>
            ),
          },
          {
            key: "run",
            header: "Job",
            render: (d) =>
              d.job_id ? (
                <Link
                  to={`/runs/${d.job_id}`}
                  className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                >
                  {d.job_id.slice(0, 8)}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                "—"
              ),
          },
          {
            key: "requested",
            header: "Requested",
            render: (d) => d.created_at.slice(0, 19),
          },
          {
            key: "status",
            header: "Status",
            render: (d) => <Badge color="amber">{d.status}</Badge>,
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No pending decisions — inbox is clear.</Empty>}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

```typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Button, Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type AgentJob,
  type AgentReview,
  type AgentToolAudit,
  type HumanDecision,
} from "../lib/db";

const SUBMISSION_OPERATIONS = new Set([
  "kaggle_submit",
  "kernel_push",
  "supabase_migrate",
  "git_push",
]);

async function callApi(
  decisionId: string,
  action: "approve" | "reject" | "ask-improve",
  body: object,
): Promise<Response> {
  const token = readApiToken();
  return fetch(`/api/decision/${decisionId}/${action}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(token ? { "X-Decision-Api-Token": token } : {}),
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

function readApiToken(): string | null {
  // Same-origin cookie set out-of-band by `kca ui login`.
  const m = document.cookie.match(/kca_api_token=([^;]+)/);
  return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
}

interface MetaState {
  decision: HumanDecision | null;
  job: AgentJob | null;
  reviews: AgentReview[];
  audit: AgentToolAudit[];
  artifactPreview: { kind: "text" | "binary" | "none"; body: string };
}

export function DecisionGate(): JSX.Element {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const [state, setState] = useState<MetaState | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"approve" | "reject" | "ask" | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const decision = await db.getDecision(id);
        const job = decision?.job_id ? await db.getJob(decision.job_id) : null;
        const reviews = decision?.job_id
          ? await db.listReviewsForJob(decision.job_id)
          : [];
        const audit = decision?.job_id
          ? await db.listToolAudit(decision.job_id, 20)
          : [];
        if (!live) return;
        setState({
          decision,
          job,
          reviews,
          audit,
          artifactPreview: { kind: "none", body: "" },
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (live) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [id]);

  const isSubmission = useMemo(() => {
    if (!state?.decision) return false;
    return SUBMISSION_OPERATIONS.has(state.decision.decision_type);
  }, [state]);

  const rejectDisabled = reason.trim().length < 8;
  const feedbackDisabled = feedback.trim().length < 1;

  async function doApprove(): Promise<void> {
    if (!id) return;
    setBusy("approve");
    try {
      const r = await callApi(id, "approve", { reason: reason || undefined });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.text()}`);
      nav("/approvals");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function doReject(): Promise<void> {
    if (!id || rejectDisabled) return;
    setBusy("reject");
    try {
      const r = await callApi(id, "reject", { reason });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.text()}`);
      nav("/approvals");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function doAskImprove(): Promise<void> {
    if (!id || feedbackDisabled) return;
    setBusy("ask");
    try {
      const r = await callApi(id, "ask-improve", { feedback });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.text()}`);
      nav("/approvals");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (!state || !state.decision) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <Empty>Decision not found.</Empty>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const { decision, job, reviews, audit } = state;
  const policyProfile =
    (job?.policy as { policy_profile?: string } | null)?.policy_profile ??
    "default";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card title={`Decision ${decision.id.slice(0, 8)}`}>
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm md:grid-cols-3">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">operation</dt>
            <dd>{decision.decision_type}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">status</dt>
            <dd>
              <Badge color="amber">{decision.status}</Badge>
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">policy profile</dt>
            <dd>{policyProfile}</dd>
          </div>
          {job && (
            <>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">cost ($)</dt>
                <dd>{(job.cost_usd ?? 0).toFixed(4)}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">turns</dt>
                <dd>{job.turns_used ?? 0}</dd>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </dl>
      </Card>

      {reviews.length > 0 && (
        <Card title="Reviewer">
          {reviews.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.id} className="rounded border border-slate-100 p-2 text-sm">
              <Badge
                color={
                  r.verdict === "approve"
                    ? "green"
                    : r.verdict === "reject"
                      ? "red"
                      : "slate"
                }
              >
                {r.verdict}
              </Badge>
              <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                {r.reviewer_model}
              </span>
              {r.rationale && (
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-700">{r.rationale}</p>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card title="Recent tool audit (last 20)">
        <Table
          rows={audit}
          columns={[
            { key: "ts", header: "ts", render: (a) => a.ts.slice(11, 19) },
            { key: "tool", header: "Tool", render: (a) => a.tool_name },
            {
              key: "decision",
              header: "Decision",
              render: (a) => (
                <Badge
                  color={
                    a.decision === "allow"
                      ? "green"
                      : a.decision === "deny"
                        ? "red"
                        : "amber"
                  }
                >
                  {a.decision}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
          ]}
          empty={<Empty>No audit rows yet.</Empty>}
        />
      </Card>

      <Card title="Actions">
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-3 rounded bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <label className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Reason (required for reject, min 8 chars)
        </label>
        <input
          className="mt-1 w-full rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-sm"
          value={reason}
          onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="why are you taking this action?"
        />

        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            data-testid="approve-btn"
            variant={isSubmission ? "danger" : "caution"}
            onClick={doApprove}
            disabled={busy !== null}
          >
            {busy === "approve" ? <Spinner /> : "Approve"}
          </Button>
          <Button
            data-testid="reject-btn"
            variant="default"
            onClick={doReject}
            disabled={busy !== null || rejectDisabled}
          >
            {busy === "reject" ? <Spinner /> : "Reject"}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
          <label className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Feedback to the agent (ask-improve)
          </label>
          <textarea
            className="mt-1 w-full rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-sm"
            rows={3}
            value={feedback}
            onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="describe what to change for the next iteration"
          />
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            className="mt-2"
            onClick={doAskImprove}
            disabled={busy !== null || feedbackDisabled}
            data-testid="ask-improve-btn"
          >
            {busy === "ask" ? <Spinner /> : "Ask agent to improve"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

});

/** Helpers shared by Artifacts + ArtifactDetail pages. */

export const MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES = 1024 * 1024; // 1 MB
export const CSV_PREVIEW_ROWS = 100;

const BINARY_EXTENSIONS = [".pkl", ".pt", ".h5", ".bin", ".so"];

const TEXT_PREFIXES = [
  "text/",
  "application/json",
  "application/x-yaml",
  "application/javascript",
];

export function isBinaryPath(path: string): boolean {
  const lower = path.toLowerCase();
  return BINARY_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => lower.endsWith(ext));
}

export function canPreview(path: string, size: number | null | undefined): {
  preview: boolean;
  reason?: string;
} {
  if (isBinaryPath(path)) {
    return { preview: false, reason: "binary extension" };
  }
  if (typeof size === "number" && size > MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES) {
    return { preview: false, reason: ">1 MB" };
  }
  return { preview: true };
}

export function looksLikeText(contentType: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!contentType) return false;
  const ct = contentType.toLowerCase();
  return TEXT_PREFIXES.some((p) => ct.startsWith(p));
}

export function capCsv(rows: string[]): string[] {
  return rows.slice(0, CSV_PREVIEW_ROWS);
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import { db, type Artifact } from "../lib/db";

export function Artifacts(): JSX.Element {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Artifact[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [jobFilter, setJobFilter] = useState("");
  const [kindFilter, setKindFilter] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    db.listArtifacts(200)
      .then(setRows)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return rows.filter((r) => {
      if (kindFilter && r.kind !== kindFilter) return false;
      if (jobFilter) {
        const md = r.metadata ?? {};
        const jid = (md as { job_id?: string }).job_id ?? "";
        if (!jid.includes(jobFilter)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [rows, kindFilter, jobFilter]);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  return (
    <Card title="Artifacts">
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">
        <label>
          Kind:&nbsp;
          <input
            value={kindFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setKindFilter(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="(any)"
            className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs"
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          Job:&nbsp;
          <input
            value={jobFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setJobFilter(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="(any)"
            className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs"
          />
        </label>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-slate-500">
          {filtered.length} artifacts
        </span>
      </div>
      <Table
        rows={filtered}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "path",
            header: "Path",
            render: (a) => (
              <Link
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                to={`/artifacts/${a.id}`}
              >
                {a.storage_path}
              </Link>
            ),
          },
          { key: "kind", header: "Kind", render: (a) => a.kind },
          {
            key: "size",
            header: "Size",
            align: "right",
            render: (a) =>
              a.byte_size != null ? `${a.byte_size.toLocaleString()} B` : "—",
          },
          {
            key: "hash",
            header: "sha256",
            render: (a) =>
              a.content_hash ? a.content_hash.slice(0, 12) : "—",
          },
          {
            key: "created",
            header: "Created",
            render: (a) => a.created_at.slice(0, 19),
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No artifacts.</Empty>}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner } from "../ui";
import { db, type Artifact } from "../lib/db";
import { canPreview } from "../lib/artifacts";

export function ArtifactDetail(): JSX.Element {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const [a, setA] = useState<Artifact | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    db.getArtifact(id)
      .then(setA)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (!a)
    return (
      <Card>
        <Empty>Artifact not found.</Empty>
      </Card>
    );

  const verdict = canPreview(a.storage_path, a.byte_size);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <Card title="Metadata">
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">path</dt>
            <dd className="font-mono">{a.storage_path}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">kind</dt>
            <dd>{a.kind}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">size</dt>
            <dd>{a.byte_size?.toLocaleString() ?? "—"} bytes</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">sha256</dt>
            <dd className="font-mono text-xs">{a.content_hash ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </Card>
      <Card title="Preview">
        {!verdict.preview && (
          <div className="rounded bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-900">
            Preview unavailable: {verdict.reason}. Use the storage path to
            download manually.
          </div>
        )}
        {verdict.preview && (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Inline preview requires a storage HEAD/GET endpoint, planned for
            M9. Until then, the artifact is downloadable via{" "}
            <code className="rounded bg-slate-100 px-1">
              {a.storage_path}
            </code>
            .
          </p>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

```

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  canPreview,
  capCsv,
  isBinaryPath,
  MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES,
  CSV_PREVIEW_ROWS,
} from "./artifacts";

describe("artifact previews", () => {
  it("blocks binary extensions from preview", () => {
    for (const ext of [".pkl", ".pt", ".h5", ".bin", ".so"]) {
      expect(isBinaryPath(`foo${ext}`)).toBe(true);
      expect(canPreview(`foo${ext}`, 100).preview).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("blocks > 1 MB files", () => {
    expect(canPreview("foo.txt", MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES + 1).preview).toBe(false);
    expect(canPreview("foo.txt", MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES - 1).preview).toBe(true);
  });

  it("caps CSV at 100 rows", () => {
    const rows = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => `row${i}`);
    const capped = capCsv(rows);
    expect(capped.length).toBe(CSV_PREVIEW_ROWS);
    expect(capped[0]).toBe("row0");
  });
});

```python
"""M8 smoke tests — audit / schema / fixture / worker / decision_api / CLI.

Mix of DB-marked and DB-less. DB-marked tests skip cleanly when
SUPABASE_DB_URL is unset.

Run with:
    python -m pytest tests/test_m8_smoke.py -v
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import textwrap
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "kca"))

requires_db = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not os.environ.get("SUPABASE_DB_URL"),
    reason="SUPABASE_DB_URL not set",
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Tool audit table present on db target
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@requires_db
def test_tool_audit_table_present_on_db_target():
    import psycopg

    with psycopg.connect(os.environ["SUPABASE_DB_URL"]) as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT to_regclass('public.agent_tool_audit') IS NOT NULL"
            )
            tbl = cur.fetchone()[0]
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT to_regclass('public.v_agent_tool_audit_recent') IS NOT NULL"
            )
            view = cur.fetchone()[0]
    assert tbl, "agent_tool_audit table missing"
    assert view, "v_agent_tool_audit_recent view missing"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Dual-write JSONL when DB unconfigured — never raises
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_tool_audit_dual_write_jsonl_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("SUPABASE_DB_URL", raising=False)
    from tools.kca.agent.audit import AuditLogger

    path = tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"
    logger = AuditLogger(backend="both", file_path=path)
    rec = logger.log_policy_decision(
        tool="bash",
        operation="bash",
        decision="ask",
        mode="default",
        policy_profile="permissive-dev",
    )
    assert path.is_file()
    line = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip().splitlines()[-1]
    payload = json.loads(line)
    assert payload["decision"] == "ask"
    assert payload["session_id"] == rec.session_id


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3 & 4. Schema validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_skill_schema_rejects_bad_name(tmp_path):
    from tools.kca.agent.skill_loader import SkillValidationError, load_skill

    d = tmp_path / "skills" / "Bad"
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "SKILL.md").write_text(
        textwrap.dedent(
            """---
            name: Bad Name
            description: x
            ---
            body
            """
        )
    )
    with pytest.raises(SkillValidationError):
        load_skill("Bad", skills_root=d.parent)


def test_skill_schema_rejects_unknown_tool(tmp_path):
    from tools.kca.agent.skill_loader import SkillValidationError, load_skill

    d = tmp_path / "skills" / "ok"
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "SKILL.md").write_text(
        textwrap.dedent(
            """---
            name: ok
            description: x
            allowed-tools:
              - made_up_tool
            ---
            body
            """
        )
    )
    with pytest.raises(SkillValidationError):
        load_skill("ok", skills_root=d.parent)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5 & 6. Fixture relocation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_skill_fixture_no_longer_in_kca_skills():
    p = REPO_ROOT / ".kca" / "skills" / "_test_fixture"
    assert not p.exists(), f"unexpected fixture dir present: {p}"


def test_skill_fixture_still_loadable_from_tests_root():
    from tools.kca.agent.skill_loader import load_skill

    root = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "fixtures" / "skills"
    s = load_skill("_test_fixture", skills_root=root)
    assert s.meta.name == "_test_fixture"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7–9. Worker tool_call paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _build_test_worker(tmp_path, monkeypatch, decision):
    """Shared setup helper for the three worker_tool_call tests."""
    import types as _types

    from src.worker._types import JobPolicy
    from src.worker.worker import AgentWorker, MockLiteLLMClient

    monkeypatch.setenv("KCA_AUDIT_PATH", str(tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"))
    (tmp_path / "hello.txt").write_text("hi")

    policy = JobPolicy(
        skill_name="_test_fixture",
        policy_profile="permissive-dev",
        mode="default",
        tool_decisions={"read_file": decision},
    )
    worker = AgentWorker(
        job_id="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
        prompt="read it",
        policy=policy,
        workspace=tmp_path,
        db_url=None,
        dry_run=True,
    )

    client = MockLiteLLMClient(scenario="two_turns")
    state = {"n": 0}

    def completion(**_kwargs):
        state["n"] += 1
        if state["n"] == 1:
            tc = _types.SimpleNamespace(
                id="c",
                type="function",
                function=_types.SimpleNamespace(
                    name="read_file",
                    arguments=json.dumps({"path": "hello.txt"}),
                ),
            )
            msg = _types.SimpleNamespace(content=None, tool_calls=[tc])
            return _types.SimpleNamespace(
                choices=[
                    _types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg, finish_reason="tool_calls")
                ],
                usage=_types.SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens=5),
            )
        msg = _types.SimpleNamespace(content="done", tool_calls=None)
        return _types.SimpleNamespace(
            choices=[_types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg, finish_reason="stop")],
            usage=_types.SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=5, completion_tokens=2),
        )

    client.completion = completion  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    worker._mock_client = client
    return worker


def _read_audit(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"
    if not p.is_file():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text().splitlines() if line]


def test_worker_tool_call_allow_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    worker = _build_test_worker(tmp_path, monkeypatch, "allow")
    result = worker.run()
    assert result.status == "done"
    rows = _read_audit(tmp_path)
    assert any(r["tool_name"] == "read_file" and r["decision"] == "allow" for r in rows)


def test_worker_tool_call_ask_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    worker = _build_test_worker(tmp_path, monkeypatch, "ask")
    result = worker.run()
    assert result.status == "paused"
    rows = _read_audit(tmp_path)
    assert any(r["decision"] == "ask" for r in rows)


def test_worker_tool_call_deny_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    worker = _build_test_worker(tmp_path, monkeypatch, "deny")
    result = worker.run()
    assert result.status == "failed"
    assert result.stop_reason == "policy_violation"
    rows = _read_audit(tmp_path)
    assert any(r["decision"] == "deny" for r in rows)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10–12. Decision API
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@pytest.fixture
def client():
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    from services.decision_api.app import make_app

    class _FakeDB:
        def __init__(self):
            self.decisions = {
                "x": {
                    "id": "x",
                    "status": "pending",
                    "job_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
                    "decision_type": "kaggle_submit",
                }
            }
            self.events: list[dict] = []

        def get_decision(self, did):
            return self.decisions.get(did)

        def resolve_decision(self, did, resolution, notes=None):
            self.decisions[did]["status"] = resolution
            self.decisions[did]["notes"] = notes

        def append_job_event(self, job_id, event_type, event_data=None, **_):
            self.events.append({"job_id": job_id, "event_type": event_type, "event_data": event_data})
            return len(self.events)

    fake = _FakeDB()
    app = make_app(decisions_module=fake, audit_logger=lambda **_: None)
    c = TestClient(app)
    c.fake = fake  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return c


def test_decision_api_approve_idempotent(client):
    r1 = client.post("/decision/x/approve", json={"reason": "ok"})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    r2 = client.post("/decision/x/approve", json={"reason": "ok"})
    assert r2.status_code == 409


def test_decision_api_reject_minlength(client):
    r = client.post("/decision/x/reject", json={"reason": "short77"})  # 7 chars
    assert r.status_code == 422
    r = client.post("/decision/x/reject", json={"reason": "explanation"})
    assert r.status_code == 200


def test_decision_api_ask_improve_appends_event(client):
    r = client.post("/decision/x/ask-improve", json={"feedback": "please try seed=42"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    fake = client.fake  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    feedback_events = [e for e in fake.events if e["event_type"] == "feedback"]
    assert feedback_events
    assert feedback_events[0]["event_data"]["feedback"].startswith("please")

# 13. kca skill run --execute
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def test_kca_skill_run_execute_creates_job(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("SUPABASE_DB_URL", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setenv("KCA_AUDIT_PATH", str(tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"))
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            str(REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "kca" / "kca.py"),
            "skill",
            "run",
            "triage-log",
            "--arg",
            "job_id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
            "--execute",
            "--json",
        ],
        env={**os.environ, "KCA_AUDIT_PATH": str(tmp_path / "audit.jsonl")},
        cwd=REPO_ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
    data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    assert data["ok"] is True
    assert "job_id" in data
    assert data["skill"] == "triage-log"

import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";

/**
 * The dev server runs against the local Supabase anon key, which the test
 * environment does not provide. To keep these tests offline, we stub the
 * supabase JS client to return empty arrays for every read.
 */
test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    interface FakeChain {
      select: (..._: unknown[]) => FakeChain;
      order: (..._: unknown[]) => FakeChain;
      eq: (..._: unknown[]) => FakeChain;
      in: (..._: unknown[]) => FakeChain;
      limit: (..._: unknown[]) => FakeChain;
      maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: null; error: null }>;
      then: (resolve: (v: { data: unknown[]; error: null }) => void) => void;
    }
    const fakeQuery = (): FakeChain => {
      const chain: FakeChain = {
        select: () => chain,
        order: () => chain,
        eq: () => chain,
        in: () => chain,
        limit: () => chain,
        maybeSingle: async () => ({ data: null, error: null }),
        then: (resolve) => resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
      };
      return chain;
    };
    (window as unknown as { __E2E_FAKE_SUPABASE__: boolean }).__E2E_FAKE_SUPABASE__ = true;
    Object.defineProperty(window, "fetch", { writable: true });
    // Replace the supabase JS module before page scripts run via a sentinel.
    (window as unknown as { supabase?: unknown }).supabase = {
      from: () => fakeQuery(),
    };
  });
});

test("dashboard_has_four_sections", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/");
  await expect(page.getByText(/^Projects$/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Active competitions/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Inflight runs/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Recent decisions/i)).toBeVisible();
});

test("approvals_inbox_renders", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/approvals");
  await expect(page.getByText(/Approval Inbox/i)).toBeVisible();
});

test("decision_gate_blocks_short_reason", async ({ page }) => {
  // We can navigate directly; mocked supabase returns null → "not found"
  // path. The button-rule UI test that actually exercises the disable
  // condition lives in DecisionGate.test.tsx (vitest). This e2e check just
  // confirms the route renders and the heading is present without throwing.
  await page.goto("/approvals/some-fake-id");
  // Either decision-not-found or Actions card — both are acceptable.
  const found = await page
    .getByText(/(Decision|not found)/i)
    .first()
    .isVisible();
  expect(found).toBeTruthy();
});

test("external_link_has_noopener", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/research");
  // The page has at least the GitHub link in the layout header.
  const links = await page.locator("a[target='_blank']").all();
  for (const link of links) {
    const rel = await link.getAttribute("rel");
    expect(rel).toMatch(/noopener/);
    expect(rel).toMatch(/noreferrer/);
  }
});

````markdown
# M8 UI Shell Architecture

_Status: M8 (2026-05-23)._

## Overview

M8 surfaces the M2–M7 control plane as a read-mostly operator workbench.
The browser is a Vite + React + TypeScript SPA that talks to Supabase
for reads (via the JS client + anon key + RLS) and to a small Python
FastAPI **decision_api** service for the three write paths a human ever
performs in the UI: approve, reject, ask-the-agent-to-improve. The
browser bundle never holds a service-role key; every mutation flows
through `services/decision_api/` which re-uses the existing
`tools/kca/decisions.py` functions and writes through
`tools/kca/db.py`, so the M7 permission policy resolution stays
authoritative.

## Layer map

```
+---------------------------+        +-------------------------+
|        Browser (SPA)      |        |   FastAPI action svc    |
|  Vite + React + RR        |        |   services/decision_api |
|                           |        |                         |
|  read path: @supabase/js  |        |  POST /decision/:id/*   |
|  write path: /api/*       |  --->  |       │                 |
+-----------┬---------------+        +-------┼-----------------+
            │                                 │
            ▼                                 ▼
        Postgres                        tools/kca/decisions.py
        (anon key,                            │
         RLS-gated)                           ▼
                                        tools/kca/db.py
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                         Postgres
                                              │
                                              ▼
                                  agent worker resume
                                  (src/worker/worker.py)
```

## Data flow per page

| Page                | Tables read                                          | Joins                                              |
|---------------------|------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Dashboard           | `projects`, `competitions`, `agent_jobs`, `human_decisions` | none (four parallel lists)                         |
| RunTimeline         | `agent_jobs`, `agent_job_events`, `agent_telemetry_spans` | `agent_telemetry_spans.job_id → agent_jobs.id`     |
| Experiments         | `experiments`, `experiment_runs`, `submissions`     | runs/subs filtered client-side per experiment id   |
| Research            | `research_items`, `research_citations`               | citations selected by `run_id` of the active item  |
| ApprovalInbox       | `human_decisions` where `status='pending'`           | none                                               |
| DecisionGate        | `human_decisions`, `agent_jobs`, `agent_reviews`, `agent_tool_audit` | reviews + audit joined on `job_id`                 |
| Artifacts           | `artifacts`                                          | filters resolved client-side (job_id metadata)     |

Every query in `ui/src/lib/db.ts` returns a typed `Promise<T[]>` or
`Promise<T | null>` and handles the no-rows case explicitly. The supabase
client falls through to an empty-array fake when `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
is empty so the SPA still renders cleanly in tests and demo previews.

## Auth model

- M8 ships **single-user, local-only**.
- The decision_api accepts a shared token in
  `KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN`; the browser supplies it via the
  `X-Decision-Api-Token` header. The token is set out-of-band by
  `kca ui login`, which writes a same-origin `kca_api_token` cookie.
- Reads from Supabase use the **anon key** + RLS. The browser never sees
  a service-role key. If anon access is too permissive for a future
  deployment, the read path should swap to Supabase RPC functions with
  `security_definer` views — that work lands in M9+.
- A grep over `ui/` for `SERVICE_ROLE` must return zero matches; this is
  enforced both by exit-criteria check #21 and by the CI `ui` job.

## Approval gate semantics

- The UI calls **three** action endpoints; nothing else:
  - `POST /decision/:id/approve` — body: `{reason?: string}`.
  - `POST /decision/:id/reject` — body: `{reason: string}` (≥ 8 chars,
    enforced by Pydantic).
  - `POST /decision/:id/ask-improve` — body:
    `{feedback: string, metric_target?: string}`.
- Each endpoint:
  1. Verifies the `X-Decision-Api-Token` if `KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN`
     is set on the server (test runs may skip the token check).
  2. Reads the `human_decisions` row. If it isn't `status='pending'`,
     returns **409 Conflict** — decisions are atomic.
  3. Calls `tools/kca/db.py::resolve_decision` for the appropriate
     terminal status (`approved` / `rejected` / `needs_improvement`).
  4. For `ask-improve`, additionally appends an
     `agent_job_events("feedback")` row so the worker picks it up on
     resume.
  5. Writes an `agent_tool_audit` row via
     `tools.kca.agent.audit.log_policy_decision`.
- The browser cannot construct a `kaggle competitions submit`
  invocation. It can only set the decision status; the actual
  submission still flows through the worker after the approval is
  recorded, and that worker is gated by the M7 permission policy.
- DecisionGate UI rule: the **Approve** button is `bg-red-600`
  (`variant="danger"`) when the operation is in the submission set
  (`kaggle_submit`, `kernel_push`, `supabase_migrate`, `git_push`).
  All other operations get `bg-amber-500` (`variant="caution"`). This
  forces a visual pause before a destructive approve.

## Audit trail

- Every action service mutation writes to `agent_tool_audit` via
  `tools.kca.agent.audit.log_policy_decision`.
- `.agent/audit.jsonl` continues to exist for offline ops; the
  dual-write behaviour from M8-T001 keeps both backends in sync when a
  DB is configured. The writer never raises on DB failure — JSONL is
  the source of truth.
- The DecisionGate page surfaces the last 20 audit rows for the job
  under review, so a human can see "what did the agent already touch?"
  before approving the next step.

## Adding a new page

1. Add the route to `ui/src/routes.tsx`.
2. Add a typed query function in `ui/src/lib/db.ts`. Reuse the
   `rows<T>(…)` / `maybeOne<T>(…)` helpers — they ensure no-rows is
   handled explicitly.
3. Create the page component under `ui/src/pages/`. Use the existing
   `ui/src/ui/*` primitives (`Card`, `Table`, `Badge`, `Empty`,
   `Spinner`) — no design-system dep.
4. Write a vitest unit test under `ui/src/pages/<Page>.test.tsx` that
   mocks `../lib/db` and asserts the section renders. (See
   `Dashboard.test.tsx` for the canonical pattern.)
5. Optional: extend `ui/tests/e2e/m8.spec.ts` with a Playwright case
   that visits the route and asserts the heading. The dev server +
   fake supabase client are already in place.

## Adding a new approve-class operation

1. Add a `ToolSpec` entry in `tools/kca/agent/tool_registry.py`,
   including its `side_effect`, `approval_label`, `sandbox`, and
   `timeout_s`.
2. Update the relevant permission profile under `.kca/permissions/` so
   the new operation has a default decision per mode.
3. Wire the worker behavior: nothing usually needed — the M8
   `_tool_call` already routes any tool through
   `JobPolicy.tool_decisions[tool_name]` + ToolSpec enforcement.
4. Render in `DecisionGate.tsx`: extend `SUBMISSION_OPERATIONS` set if
   the new op should get the red destructive button.
5. Add a smoke test in `tests/test_m8_smoke.py` (or a dedicated
   `tests/test_m9_*.py` for new milestones) that exercises the
   approve/reject path.
6. Document the new gate in this file's "Approval gate semantics"
   section.

````
